description: Accessibility and consistency pass (plan.md decision 8, checklist A1-A10) and the M8 docs: skip link and labelled landmarks, global :focus-visible, a token contrast unit test (fails today on light --success and dark --danger over --surface-2) with minimal token fixes, field hint/error association, page titles for every tab and the match room, heading order on the matches page, aria-live checks, keyboard and empty-state checks, danger styling for destructive buttons; then docs/PLAN.md M8 ✅ with its Done when and '## Implementation notes (M8)', and a final README pass. Runs last; small fixes in the existing style, no redesigns.
steps:
A1: src/routes/+layout.svelte: first element `{m.skip_to_content()}` ('Skip to content'); `
`; header `
` ('Main'; never a label containing 'Tournament'). src/routes/settings/+layout.svelte nav `aria-label={m.settings_title()}`. src/lib/styles/global.scss `.skip-link` (absolute, off-screen; on :focus visible at the top left with surface background, border and padding). e2e/auth.e2e.ts: on '/', `page.keyboard.press('Tab')` focuses the 'Skip to content' link.

A2: src/lib/styles/global.scss: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` and `[tabindex='-1']:focus { outline: none; }`; keep the input :focus rule and PanZoom's own outline.

A3: new src/lib/styles/contrast.spec.ts (pure, node:fs): read src/lib/styles/_tokens.scss, take the bodies of `@mixin tokens-light` and `@mixin tokens-dark`, parse `--name: #rrggbb;`, compute WCAG relative luminance and contrast, and assert >= 4.5 in both modes for: text, text-muted, accent on bg/surface/surface-2; danger and success on surface/surface-2; warning-text on warning-bg; accent-text on accent and accent-hover (one `it.each` row per pair and mode, so failures name the pair). It fails today on light success/surface-2 (4.49) and dark danger/surface-2 (4.49): change only those two tokens minimally in _tokens.scss (e.g. light `--success: #2a7a2e`, dark `--danger: #f05a56`) until it passes.

A4: fields: hints get `id="-hint"`; errors render as one `{#if errors.x}{errors.x.join(' ')}{/if}`; the input gets `aria-describedby="-hint -error"` (only ids that can exist in that field) and `aria-invalid={errors.x ? 'true' : undefined}`. Files: src/routes/settings/+page.svelte, src/lib/components/OrganizationFields.svelte, src/routes/o/[org]/admin/+page.svelte (delete confirm + deleteError), src/routes/o/[org]/admin/tournaments/+page.svelte, src/routes/o/[org]/admin/api-keys/+page.svelte, src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/+page.svelte (all fields + delete confirm), src/lib/components/DateTimeInput.svelte (optional `describedby` prop on the visible input), src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/participants/+page.svelte, src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/requirements/+page.svelte, src/lib/components/StageFields.svelte, src/lib/components/GamePicker.svelte.

A5: titles `{section} · {context} · {m.app_name()}` from the current tab (`tabs.find((tab) => tab.route === page.route.id)`): src/routes/settings/+layout.svelte, src/routes/o/[org]/admin/+layout.svelte, src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/+layout.svelte, src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/+layout.svelte (Overview keeps `{tournament} · {app}`; only when not admin, as today); src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.svelte sets `{m.match_number({ number })} · {tournament} · {app}` (needs the tournament name from layout data).

A6: src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/+page.svelte: when data.stageCount === 1, group headings are h2 (e.g. `<svelte:element this={data.stageCount > 1 ? 'h3' : 'h2'}>`), so no level is skipped. Confirm the rest (profile, dashboard, room, bracket, admin matches, docs) and note it in the checklist.

A7-A9: verify and tick: LiveStatus role=status (FEAT-003), MatchChat role=log, GamePicker status (FEAT-001), alerts role=alert/status; grep `on(click|keydown)=` over src/**/*.svelte shows only buttons and the PanZoom viewport; every list has a `

` empty state (dashboard, org page, admin tournaments, API keys, participants, matches, queue, chat, bracket, profile, picker). Fix any gap found.

A10: destructive buttons get `danger`: 'Clear' result in src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.svelte and src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/matches/+page.svelte (`btn small danger`); confirm 'Remove game' already has it.
Tick A1-A10 in plan.md's checklist with the files touched.

docs/PLAN.md: replace the M8 milestones row with the text in plan.md ('docs/PLAN.md' section), marking M8 ✅ with its Done when; add `## Implementation notes (M8)` after the M7 notes in the same terse style, adapted from the FEAT-001..004 findings (draft in plan.md); in Architecture add `profiles, steam` to the services comment; in the Data model add `tournaments.game` ({ appId, name, headerImage }) and `steam_apps` / `steam_app_list (fetchedAt, attemptedAt)`; in Integrations one line on the cache and refresh rule. Record in `findings` the final test counts for the commit message.
